title: Understanding the Function
text: The function given is $$f(x)=\frac{1}{\pi} \arctan\left(x\right)+\frac{1}{2}$$. This function is similar to the logistic function in terms of its behavior at the tails.

title: Behavior of the Function
text: Observe the graph. The function approaches $$0$$ as $$x$$ approaches negative infinity and approaches $$1$$ as $$x$$ approaches positive $$\infty$$.

title: Comparison with Logistic Function
text: Both the logistic function and the given function have similar asymptotic behavior, meaning they both approach $$0$$ and $$1$$ at the extremes.
